function mountWebGpuWidget(kind, canvas, loadModule?, options?): Promise<WidgetHandle | null>

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/webgpu-widget.ts:269

Mounts a widget artifact on canvas: loads its wasm module, calls init, wires resize + visibility-paused rAF, and returns the live handle. Resolves null on any capability/artifact/init failure — the caller's WebGL/CSS renderer stays the render path.

Parameters

kind

number

GPU_WIDGET_KINDS discriminant.

The widget's dedicated canvas element.

(url) => Promise<WidgetModule>

Injectable module loader (tests substitute a stub).

MountOptions = {}

Mount options — GPU_WIDGET_DRIVE.MANUAL leaves the clock + resize to the caller's own loop.
